name: Vivo V80 FE
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 7400 Turbo is a strong mid-range gaming chip — popular titles run smoothly at high settings, and the 120Hz AMOLED display keeps gameplay fluid. The 7,000mAh battery easily lasts through long gaming sessions.

name: Oppo Reno 17 Pro
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 8550 Super is a strong upper-mid-range chip — heavy games run smoothly on high settings with 120fps support, and the 7,250mAh battery keeps long sessions going.

name: Oppo Reno 17
gaming_notes: The Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 is a powerful mid-range chip — heavy games run smoothly on high settings, and Oppo adds 120fps gaming support. The 8,000mAh battery makes long gaming sessions easy too.

name: Vivo V80
gaming_notes: The Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 is a solid midrange gaming chip that runs popular titles smoothly at medium-high settings; the 144Hz 1.5K AMOLED display makes gameplay feel fluid.

name: Poco X8 Pro 5G
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 8500 Ultra (AnTuTu ~2.07M) with a 120Hz 1.5K AMOLED, 6,500mAh battery and 100W charging makes this a strong gaming phone at the price — heavy titles run smoothly at high settings, and bypass-style sustained play is helped by the large battery.

name: Vivo Y6k
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 6300 handles casual games, but demanding titles need low settings on the 720p display. The 6,500mAh battery is the real gaming asset - it lasts for days of play.

name: Motorola Signature 27
gaming_notes: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is the most powerful chip yet — any game will run effortlessly on it.

name: Nubia A57
gaming_notes: The Unisoc T7250 is an entry-level chip: light games run fine, but heavy titles need low settings. The 120Hz display and 5,000mAh battery help for casual play.

name: Nubia RedMagic 12 Pro
gaming_notes: Purpose-built esports flagship: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 + RedCore R5, 185Hz 1.5K OLED, RGB liquid cooling with a 25,500 RPM fan, bypass charging and an 8400mAh battery for sustained peak performance. The global model's 80W charging and 520Hz triggers are small steps down from the China Pro+.

name: Redmi M100 Pro
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 7300-Ultra with a 120Hz AMOLED and a 5500mAh battery is a strong mid-range gaming combination — smooth play in most titles at high settings, with only the most demanding games needing a step down.

name: Nokia 2360 Flip
gaming_notes: A 2G feature phone on S30+ with 4MB of memory — no smartphone games at all; only the built-in basic games, if any, will run.

name: Nubia Air Pro 5G
gaming_notes: The Dimensity 7100 with a 144Hz AMOLED, bypass charging and a 5000mAh battery is a strong mid-range gaming combination — smooth play in most titles at high settings, with only the most demanding games needing a step down.
